mcqs.q: Through which Constitutional Amendment Act was Delhi designated as the 'National Capital Territory of Delhi' (NCT) with a Legislative Assembly in 1991?
mcqs.questionText: Through which Constitutional Amendment Act was Delhi designated as the 'National Capital Territory of Delhi' (NCT) with a Legislative Assembly in 1991?
mcqs.qHi: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा केंद्र शासित प्रदेश दिल्ली को 'राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र' (NCT) के रूप में पुनर्गठित किया गया?
mcqs.questionTextHi: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा केंद्र शासित प्रदेश दिल्ली को 'राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र' (NCT) के रूप में पुनर्गठित किया गया?
mcqs.exp: The 69th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1991 inserted Articles 239AA and 239AB into the Indian Constitution, creating the NCT of Delhi.
mcqs.explanation: The 69th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1991 inserted Articles 239AA and 239AB into the Indian Constitution, creating the NCT of Delhi.
mcqs.expHi: 69वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम 1991 ने संविधान में अनुच्छेद 239AA जोड़कर दिल्ली को 70 सदस्यीय विधानसभा के साथ राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र का दर्जा दिया।
mcqs.explanationHi: 69वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम 1991 ने संविधान में अनुच्छेद 239AA जोड़कर दिल्ली को 70 सदस्यीय विधानसभा के साथ राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र का दर्जा दिया।

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Delhi (NCT).

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is New Delhi. Delhi (NCT) covers a geographic area of 1,484 sq km across 11 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Yamuna River.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: National Capital Territory of India. Seat of the Union Government, Parliament of India, and Supreme Court. Historic city built and rebuilt over millennia (Seven Historical Cities of Delhi).

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Delhi (NCT).

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Delhi (NCT) was formally instituted on 1 February 1992 (as NCT via 69th Amendment). Official language(s): Hindi, English, Urdu, Punjabi.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Kathak, Contemporary theatre.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Republic Day Parade, Independence Day at Red Fort, Qutub Festival.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Delhi (NCT).

facts.title: Lieutenant Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Lieutenant Governor is Vinai Kumar Saxena.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Delhi (NCT) is Atishi Marlena.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Delhi High Court (est. 1966).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Nilgai | State Bird: House sparrow | State Flower: Alfalfa | State Tree: Flamboyant (Gulmohar).

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Delhi (NCT).

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Silica sand, China clay (Southern Ridge).

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Delhi (NCT) plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Delhi (NCT).

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Red Fort (UNESCO), Qutub Minar (UNESCO), Humayun's Tomb (UNESCO), India Gate, Rashtrapati Bhavan, Lotus Temple, Akshardham Temple.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Asola Bhatti Wildlife Sanctuary.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Delhi (NCT).

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Mukhyamantri Mahila Samman Yojana, Free Bus Travel for Women, Delhi Solar Policy.
